subject: Renegotiate AWS Marketplace credits / propose escrow bridge
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: renegotiate AWS marketplace credit escrow and listing fee transition

Hi team,

We need to open formal discussions with AWS on our upcoming listing fee transition and the unused-credit exposure from the prior listing period. The key asks:
- Establish a 90-day "escrow bridge" of listing credits to smooth the transition between legacy credits and the new program.
- Lock in a tiered listing fee schedule for H2 (to prevent surprise increases during product launches).
- Confirm telemetry / usage sampling they need to validate the escrow amount.

Attachments: current_agreement_AWS_2025.pdf (our executed listing addendum), usage_dashboard_Q2.csv (token/embedding breakdown by month).

Constraints: Legal wants a simple addendum (no large SOW). Finance flagged a one-time exposure cap of $150k - clearance required from Marissa to go above this.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to lead the price/fees ask (we should ask for the escrow + 25% buffer).
2) Laura to coordinate procurement & legal checklist.
3) Aditya to pull usage projection for the next 6 months.

Can we get an internal alignment note by EOD tomorrow so I can loop AWS?

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: current_agreement_AWS_2025.pdf (PDF, 412 KB)
Attachment: usage_dashboard_Q2.csv (CSV, 86 KB)

From: Nadia Singh <nadia.singh@amazon.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@gcp-partners.com>, ProcureCo <sarah@procureco.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: renegotiate AWS marketplace credit escrow and listing fee transition

Thanks for the detailed note Camila - appreciate the clarity. A few items from our side:

1) Escrow bridge: AWS Marketplace can support a time-limited credit hold (escrow) for partners in transition. Standard approach is 60-90 days with a reconciliation at the end of the period. We can draft language that automatically releases unused credits back to AWS or converts a portion to listing credits depending on usage.

2) Fee schedule: We can offer a 3-tier fee cadence tied to monthly spend bands. For Redwood specifically, given your historical profile, I can propose a floor (1.6%) for months < $250k, 1.35% for $250k-$1M, and 0.95% above $1M - conditional on committing to a 12-month listing term.

3) Telemetry: To size the escrow, we need a 6-month token-level sample (preferably anonymized). If Redwood can provide a CSV with monthly tokens per model and embeddings count for the last 6 months, we can run our reconciliation model.

I'll put a draft proposal together (aws_proposal_v1.pdf) and share it by end of day Monday. Also looping in Sarah from ProcureCo as they can help on contract language if you prefer a neutral review.

Best,
Nadia Singh
Strategic Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
nadia.singh@amazon.com

--
Attachment: aws_proposal_v1.pdf (PDF, 128 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Singh <nadia.singh@amazon.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: renegotiate AWS marketplace credit escrow and listing fee transition

On Fri, Aug 20, 2027 at 11:03 AM Nadia Singh <nadia.singh@amazon.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the detailed note Camila - appreciate the clarity. A few items from our side:
>
> 1) Escrow bridge: AWS Marketplace can support a time-limited credit hold (escrow) for partners in transition. Standard approach is 60-90 days...

Nadia - thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications and asks from Redwood's side:

- Escrow sizing: we'll share the 6-month anonymized token/embedding CSV. Our ask is the escrow to be calculated conservatively (we recommend using the higher of actual monthly spend or projected ramp x1.25). That buffer protects us against a mid-quarter spike.
- Fee schedule: your bands look reasonable. Can you provide the explicit mapping (example calc) and confirm whether the percentage is applied pre- or post-marketplace-discounts? We need to model net economics.
- Contract terms: we prefer the escrow to be implemented as a short addendum with automated reconciliation and a written cap (we're comfortable up to $150k without extra approvals). Anything above that triggers leadership sign-off.

Attaching our usage snapshot: redwood_usage_profile_aug2027.xlsx (token and embedding monthly breakdown, model mix). I can make myself available Monday morning for a 30-min call to walk through the file.

Ben Carter
Director, Business Development | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

--
Attachment: redwood_usage_profile_aug2027.xlsx (XLSX, 96 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: renegotiate AWS marketplace credit escrow and listing fee transition

Team - quick decision to enable outreach: approved to pursue the 90-day escrow bridge and the proposed tiered fee schedule as long as the escrow cap stays at or below $150k without additional sign-off. If Nadia's proposal requires a higher exposure, loop Legal + Finance for fast-track approval.

Action items:
- Ben: run the P&L model with Nadia's bands and confirm net revenue at each band by Tuesday.
- Laura: prepare the procurement addendum template and confirm the acceptance criteria for the reconciliation (what data points must match).
- Aditya: finalize the 6-month anonymized telemetry and share the CSV link in this thread.
- Camila: book the working session with AWS (30-min) and include Sarah from ProcureCo for neutral contract review.

I'll be out Wednesday but reachable by phone if something urgent comes up. Good work - move quickly on the call.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
